{{DISPLAYTITLE:adamkopacz}}
'''adamkopacz''' is a creator whose image is used on two [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of adamkopacz @ Reddit". The credit points to Reddit, a discussion site. The credited cards are [[Outrider (V) (ALT)|•Outrider (V) (AI)]] and [[This Is Our Rebellion|•This Is Our Rebellion]], in [[Virtual Set 18]] and [[Virtual Set 19]] (released 2022).
